title: Weaver Recreation Redesign
subtitle: Public Amphitheater
summary: A redesign of the Weaver Recreation site in Cincinnati’s West End as a public amphitheater landscape: concentric seating rings around a central stage pavilion, planted garden rooms, and looping paths that stitch the block together. Site plan and aerial renderings by Matthew Reindl, UC DAAP MLA.

sections.heading: Brief
sections.body: A West End recreation site redesigned around civic gathering: concentric amphitheater seating around a glazed stage pavilion with a folded roof, circular planted garden rooms, and looping paths that knit the block together — with the existing corner building kept in use.
